subject: Post-call: FinOptics security evidence & retention — action plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finoptics.com>, Samir Patel <devops@finoptics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: FinOptics security evidence & retention — action plan

Hi Lena / Samir — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick written recap so we have a clear set of asks and owners. Please correct anything I get wrong.

TL;DR — primary goals you shared: 1) SOC 2 Type II evidence for our onboarding window (Dec/Jan), 2) audit-log retention and export for a 7 year legal requirement in a subset of workloads, 3) DPA language alignment for EU data residency on a small set of PII fields, 4) independent pen test report and remediation confirmation.

Pain points you called out:
- Existing procurement schedule requires SOC 2 evidence before procurement sign-off (targeting 2027-01-15).
- Internal audit needs proof of immutable audit logs (readable export + SHA integrity) for a 7-year retention window on transaction logs only.
- DPA redlines: you need a clause that explicitly states where customer metadata is stored and a technical description of controls (KMS/HSM usage).
- Pen test: you want evidence of a recent independent pen test (last 12 months) and the remediation sign-off notes.

What Redwood can provide (proposed):
- Redwood SOC 2 summary + mapping doc (attached: redwood-soc2-overview.pdf).
- Per-account evidence extraction guide + sample exports (we will provide an evidence-request-template.csv to map fields).
- Audit log retention/playbook for immutable storage and export with checksum approach — proposed commit: 7 years for transaction logs only, configurable retention for other logs.
- Latest pen test executive summary (we can share redacted report + remediation timeline) — Rishi to confirm exact artifacts we can share.

Immediate next steps we agreed on:
1) FinOptics to confirm which data classes need EU residency vs. US (Samir) — due 2026-12-03.
2) Redwood will deliver a first-cut evidence checklist + sample export within 3 business days (attachment: evidence-request-template.csv).
3) Rishi will follow up with a definitive list of redacted pen test artifacts and the expected timeline for sharing (target 2026-12-07).
4) Schedule a 30-minute sync to review evidence templates and DPA redlines (proposed: 2026-12-08) — Kimberly to send calendar invite.

Please reply in-thread with any missing items or to push alternate dates.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Director, GTM Security Programs
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: redwood-soc2-overview.pdf (summary, mapping), evidence-request-template.csv (fields we need to extract)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finoptics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <devops@finoptics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 18:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinOptics security evidence & retention — action plan

Thanks Kimberly — this is perfect and captures the conversation. A couple clarifications from our side so we can triage internally: 

- Retention scope: we only require 7-year immutable retention for payment transaction logs and settlement records. Session traces and debug logs can be 90 days.
- EU residency: we have two data classes that must stay in EU at rest (customer PII and billing metadata). We will send a redlined DPA with suggested language; hope to have that to you by 2026-12-02.
- Pen test: we need the independent test report (executive summary ok to start) and a separate confirmation that any high/critical findings were remediated or have a compensating control.

Actioning now: I will confirm the exact field list for the transaction logs and share the vendor list for the pen test by 2026-12-03. Attaching our internal compliance checklist for reference.

Lena Ortiz
Head of Security
FinOptics
lena.ortiz@finoptics.com

Attachment: finoptics-compliance-checklist.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: FinOptics security evidence & retention — action plan

Kimberly / Marissa — forward of Lena's note. High-level quick plan from infra/security side: 

1) Pen test artifacts: We can share the redacted executive summary and an internal remediation tracker that shows status by CVE/finding. We'll redact customer-identifying info. ETA: 2026-12-06.
2) Audit logs: We already support per-account export of transaction logs with an append-only S3-backed retention tier. I will draft a one-page tech note describing the checksum approach and how a customer can trigger an export. ETA: 2026-12-04.
3) Evidence mapping: I can take the evidence-request-template.csv and annotate which assets we can provide programmatically vs. manual pull. I'll attach that annotated CSV on 2026-12-03.
4) DPA redlines: legal will review once we get FinOptics redline; engineering will confirm any technical implications within 48 hours of receiving the redline.

I'll be on the 12/08 sync, but if Kimberly schedules earlier I'll try to join.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Staff Security Engineer, Red Team
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
